title: Data Selection for LLM Alignment Using Fine-Grained Preferences
authors_zh: Jia Zhang、Yao Liu、Chen-Xi Zhang、Yi Liu、Yi-Xuan Jin、Lan-Zhe Guo、Yu-Feng Li（南京大学、阿里巴巴淘天集团）
paper_type_zh: 细粒度偏好数据选择与对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合清洗含多个已标注价值或行为维度的偏好数据的读者。
one_line: The method filters fine-grained preference records by cross-aspect consensus before standard DPO, retaining samples with the most negative preference divergence.
该方法先按跨维度偏好共识过滤细粒度偏好记录，再进行标准 DPO，保留偏好分歧最负的样本。
why: It turns cross-aspect conflict into a measurable training-data exclusion rule instead of asking a single holistic label to resolve every value tradeoff.
inclusion_reason: It makes agreement among fine-grained preference aspects an explicit filter deciding which preference records train DPO.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fine-grained preference labels are easier to collect than one global judgment, but combining aspects such as helpfulness, honesty, and instruction following produces conflicts and noisy records. Standard DPO treats every pair as compatible evidence, so conflicting records can dilute or degrade the learned behavior.

The paper asks which aspect-specific pairs should be retained when several preferences disagree. It treats cross-aspect agreement as a property of the training record: use a subset whose local preference is supported by the other preference aspects, then train ordinary DPO on that subset.

细粒度偏好标签比单一全局判断更容易收集，但将有帮助、诚实和指令遵循等维度合并会产生冲突和噪声记录。标准 DPO 把每个样本对都视为兼容证据，因此冲突记录可能稀释或损害学到的行为。

论文询问，当多个偏好不一致时应保留哪些维度特定的样本对。它把跨维度一致性视为训练记录的属性：使用局部偏好得到其他偏好维度支持的子集，再在该子集上训练普通 DPO。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The authors derive a fine-grained DPO objective containing a preference-divergence term. A negative value indicates that the chosen response under one aspect is also favored by the other aspects, whereas a positive value signals conflict with the broader preference set.

Rather than optimize this complicated objective directly, the method uses divergence as a filter. Selecting the most negative values preserves consensus records and discards records that would ask the policy to follow an aspect-specific ranking opposed by the rest of the dataset.

作者推导出含有偏好分歧项的细粒度 DPO 目标。负值表示某一维度下的优选回答也受到其他维度的支持，而正值表示它与更广泛的偏好集合发生冲突。

该方法不直接优化这个复杂目标，而是将分歧用作过滤器。选择最负的值会保留共识记录，并丢弃那些要求策略遵循一个被数据集其余部分反对的维度特定排序的记录。

title: Method
方法
html:
For every preference aspect, a smaller proxy reward model is trained with balanced length sampling and a length penalty. It predicts each aspect's reward gap on records from all other aspects; quantile scaling makes the gaps comparable, and their negative sum becomes the estimated preference-divergence score.

The pipeline keeps the most negative records within a budget and applies standard DPO. The experiments construct aspect-specific collections from UltraFeedback and HelpSteer, compare 20 to 50 percent budgets, and use controlled datasets with different conflict rates to test the selection rule.

对于每个偏好维度，先以长度平衡采样和长度惩罚训练较小的代理奖励模型。它在所有其他维度的记录上预测该维度的奖励差；分位数缩放使这些差值可比较，其负和成为估计的偏好分歧分数。

流程在预算范围内保留分数最负的记录，再应用标准 DPO。实验从 UltraFeedback 和 HelpSteer 构造维度特定集合，比较 20% 到 50% 的预算，并用不同冲突率的受控数据集测试选择规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With a 30 percent selection budget on UltraFeedback, the reported Llama-3.1-8B result reaches 21.00 raw and 26.11 length-controlled AlpacaEval 2 win rate, compared with 15.18 and 21.14 for full-data DPO. On HelpSteer, the selected method reports 7.55 raw and 12.13 length-controlled win rate.

Under controlled 10, 20, and 30 percent conflict settings, the method remains above full-data and random-subset baselines in the reported table. The paper also finds that performance varies with the selection budget and evaluates transfer to Qwen2.5 plus a real Taobao Live application.

在 UltraFeedback 上使用 30% 选择预算时，报告的 Llama-3.1-8B 结果达到 21.00 的原始 AlpacaEval 2 胜率和 26.11 的长度控制胜率，而全量 DPO 分别为 15.18 和 21.14。在 HelpSteer 上，所选方法报告 7.55 的原始胜率和 12.13 的长度控制胜率。

在受控的 10%、20% 和 30% 冲突设置下，该方法在报告表中始终高于全量数据和随机子集基线。论文还发现性能会随选择预算变化，并评估了向 Qwen2.5 以及真实淘宝直播应用的迁移。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most preference filtering methods score a record using one global reward or difficulty estimate. This work makes disagreement among several annotated aspects the selection target, so a record is valued for cross-aspect consensus rather than only for confidence under its own label.

The paper separates record selection from the new fine-grained objective it derives. Its practical contribution is a portable data contract: aspect, pair, cross-aspect reward gaps, normalized divergence, and selection decision, followed by unchanged DPO.

多数偏好过滤方法使用一个全局奖励或难度估计为记录打分。这项工作把多个已标注维度之间的分歧作为选择目标，因此记录的价值来自跨维度共识，而不仅是其自身标签下的置信度。

论文将记录选择与其推导出的新细粒度目标分开。其实用贡献是一份可迁移的数据契约：维度、样本对、跨维度奖励差、归一化分歧和选择决策，随后使用不变的 DPO。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The rule requires aspect labels and proxy reward models that generalize across aspects; errors in those models or shared blind spots can make consensus misleading. It also focuses on reconciling records viewed as noise rather than preserving deliberate value trade-offs, reports no dedicated contamination audit, and declares neither code nor a new public dataset.
该规则需要维度标签和能够跨维度泛化的代理奖励模型；这些模型的错误或共同盲点会使共识产生误导。它还侧重于调和被视为噪声的记录，而不是保留有意的价值权衡；论文未报告专门的污染审计，也未声明代码或新的公开数据集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when preference data already carries several interpretable criteria and a single preference label would hide conflicts. It provides an auditable way to decide data inclusion before DPO, while retaining the aspect labels and proxy scores needed to inspect why a record was filtered.
当偏好数据已经包含多个可解释准则、而单一偏好标签会掩盖冲突时，可以使用这篇论文。它提供了在 DPO 前决定数据是否纳入的可审计方法，同时保留维度标签和代理分数，以检查记录为何被过滤。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the divergence definition with the proxy-reward estimation procedure: the method is only as meaningful as the aspect taxonomy and the cross-aspect predictions. Its clearest claim is data efficiency under conflict, not that all disagreement is undesirable; a deployment should distinguish noisy labels from legitimate policy trade-offs before filtering.
应将分歧定义与代理奖励估计流程一同阅读：该方法的意义取决于维度分类体系和跨维度预测。它最清晰的主张是在冲突下的数据效率，而不是所有分歧都不受欢迎；部署前应先区分噪声标签和合理的策略权衡，再进行过滤。
